title: Molecular mechanisms of the effects of N-ethylmaleimide and 1,4-dithioerythritol on regulation of apoptosis in P19 cells under hypoxia
central_claims: In hypoxic P19 mouse teratocarcinoma cells, 5 mM NEM promotes apoptosis with redox/protein-modification changes, whereas 5 mM DTE promotes resistance to cell death.
Glutathione redox status and protein glutathionylation/carbonylation are proposed targets for regulating tumor cell death under hypoxia.
